problem: Lucy reads $6$ pages of her new book each day. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the number of pages $P(t)$ Lucy has left to read? Assume that the time $t$ is measured in days.
worked_solution:
If the number of pages Lucy has left to read is $P$, then the rate of change of the number of the pages is $\frac{\text{d}P}{\text{d}t},$ where $t$ is the time in days.

Since Lucy reads $6$ pages every day, the rate of change of the number of pages she has left is given by the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}P}{\text{d}t}=-6.
$$

The right-hand side is negative because the number of pages Lucy has left to read is *decreasing*.
